entities.summary: The Kyiv National University of Construction and Architecture – better known under its former name abbr. KISI or KIBI for rendering of Kyiv Civil Engineering Institute – is the largest and most important civil engineering, construction and architectural university of Ukraine located in the nation's capital, Kyiv.
